lines.zh: 我两腿一蹬，蹦出一小段距离。
lines.en: I push off both legs and hop a short way.

lines.zh: 长鼻子贴着地，我边走边闻。
lines.en: Long snout to the ground, I sniff as I go.

lines.zh: 尾巴举在身后，替我配平。
lines.en: My tail rides behind me to keep me level.

lines.zh: 落地很轻，几乎听不见声音。
lines.en: I land so light you would hardly hear it.

lines.zh: 我蹦三步，停下来听一下。
lines.en: Three hops, then a pause to listen.

lines.zh: 长草挡路，我从缝隙里钻。
lines.en: Tall grass blocks me, so I slip through gaps.

lines.zh: 个子小，我走在落叶的边缘。
lines.en: Being small, I walk along the leaf litter's edge.

lines.zh: 我加快节奏，蹦得又低又快。
lines.en: I quicken the rhythm, hopping low and fast.

lines.zh: 脚掌一沾地就又弹起来。
lines.en: The moment my feet touch, I spring again.

lines.zh: 我绕着那丛灌木走了半圈。
lines.en: I make a half circle around the bush.

lines.zh: 鼻子先探出去，身子才跟上。
lines.en: My snout probes ahead before my body follows.

lines.zh: 我沿着水沟走，那边虫多。
lines.en: I follow the ditch, where the bugs are.

lines.zh: 身后留下一串小小的蹬痕。
lines.en: A trail of tiny push marks stays behind me.

lines.zh: 同伴跳过去，我也跟着跳。
lines.en: A herdmate hops across and I hop after.

lines.zh: 这条路线我走过很多次了。
lines.en: I have taken this route many times.

lines.zh: 我低头躲过一根横枝。
lines.en: I duck under a low branch.

lines.zh: 落地时草叶弹了一下。
lines.en: A blade of grass springs back as I land.

lines.zh: 走到空地边上，我放慢速度。
lines.en: At the edge of the clearing I slow down.

lines.zh: 我蹲在后腿上，鼻子一直抽动。
lines.en: Squatting on my hind legs, my snout keeps twitching.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听土里的动静。
lines.en: I tilt an ear to the sounds in the soil.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我把身子压低。
lines.en: A gust comes and I press myself low.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻点地，我在打拍子。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground, keeping time.

lines.zh: 我就这么蹲着，眼睛到处扫。
lines.en: I squat and let my eyes sweep around.

lines.zh: 有只虫爬过，我盯了很久。
lines.en: A bug crawls by and I watch it for ages.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔鼻子，又停下不动。
lines.en: I lick my snout and go still again.

lines.zh: 阳光暖，我把背上的毛晒开。
lines.en: The sun is warm and I fluff my back.

lines.zh: 我缩成一个圆圆的小团。
lines.en: I tuck into a small round bundle.

lines.zh: 远处有响动，我抬起头。
lines.en: A noise far off and my head comes up.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一块土。
lines.en: I hold still and pass for a clod of earth.

lines.zh: 肚子咕了一声，我当没听见。
lines.en: My stomach rumbles and I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我把前爪收在胸前，很舒服。
lines.en: I fold my forepaws to my chest; comfortable.

lines.zh: 风停了，我才敢放松一点。
lines.en: When the wind dies, I dare to relax a little.

lines.zh: 我甩甩耳朵，赶走一只蚊。
lines.en: I flick my ears to shed a mosquito.

lines.zh: 我蹲得很低，草尖刚好盖住我。
lines.en: I squat so low the grass tips hide me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻尖朝你抽了抽。
lines.en: I raise my head and twitch my snout at you.

lines.zh: 你这么大一团，我得仰着看。
lines.en: You are such a large mass that I must look up.

lines.zh: 我先闻闻你，再决定怕不怕。
lines.en: I smell you first, then decide whether to fear you.

lines.zh: 我往后挪了半步，眼睛没离开。
lines.en: I shift back half a step without looking away.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我缩了缩。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and I shrink a little.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，猜你要不要抓我。
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering if you mean to grab me.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，就这样僵着。
lines.en: You hold still, I hold still, and we stay that way.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的一声，像在问。
lines.en: I make a soft note, almost a question.

lines.zh: 你脚边有虫，我其实在看那个。
lines.en: There is a bug by your foot, and that is what I watch.

lines.zh: 我跳开一小步，又回头看。
lines.en: I hop a small step away and look back.

lines.zh: 你的手垂着，我盯着那几根指头。
lines.en: Your hand hangs low and I watch those fingers.

lines.zh: 我蹲在原地，鼻尖对准你的膝盖。
lines.en: I squat where I am, snout aimed at your knee.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着蹦开，腿都在抖。
lines.en: I squeal and hop away, legs trembling.

lines.zh: 疼得我蜷成一团。
lines.en: The pain curls me into a ball.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我背上，我趴了下去。
lines.en: The blow lands on my back and I flatten out.

lines.zh: 我鼻子发酸，眼睛都花了。
lines.en: My snout stings and my sight swims.

lines.zh: 我拖着后腿挪了两步。
lines.en: I drag myself two steps on a bad leg.

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼，那东西还在。
lines.en: I glance back; the thing is still there.

lines.zh: 我拼命蹬地，却跑不快。
lines.en: I push off hard and still cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 血滴在草叶上，很显眼。
lines.en: Blood on the grass stands out clearly.

lines.zh: 我发出细细的哀叫。
lines.en: I make a thin, keening cry.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，经不起几下。
lines.en: A body this small cannot take many blows.

lines.zh: 虫子的味道一飘来，我就凑近。
lines.en: The smell of insects drifts over and I close in.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something moves in your hand and I see it.

lines.zh: 我蹦到你脚前，鼻子先到。
lines.en: I hop to your feet, snout first.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也就够一口。
lines.en: Something that small is barely a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我叼住就退开两步再吃。
lines.en: I snatch it and back off two steps to eat.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，等你再抖一抖。
lines.en: I look up at you, waiting for another shake.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸进你掌心嗅。
lines.en: I push my snout into your palm and sniff.

lines.zh: 味道对了，我的尾巴都翘起来。
lines.en: The smell is right and my tail lifts.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边嚼得很快。
lines.en: I eat quickly, chewing fast.

lines.zh: 你要是松手，我立刻就跑。
lines.en: If you let go, I bolt at once.

lines.zh: 我跟着你转了两圈，实在馋。
lines.en: I circle you twice; I really am tempted.

lines.zh: 这一口不够，我还想要。
lines.en: One bite is not enough; I want more.

lines.zh: 我把前爪搭在你鞋尖上。
lines.en: I rest my forepaws on your shoe tip.

lines.zh: 有吃的，我连害怕都忘了。
lines.en: With food in reach, I forget to be afraid.

lines.zh: 我嗅到你袖口，那里也有味道。
lines.en: I sniff your sleeve; there is a smell there too.

lines.zh: 吃完我舔舔鼻子，看看你。
lines.en: Finished, I lick my snout and look at you.

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧翻，赶紧爬起来。
lines.en: The bump rolls me over and I scramble up.

lines.zh: 你这么一挤，我蹦出去老远。
lines.en: That shove sends me hopping far off.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，钻进草里。
lines.en: I squeak and dive into the grass.

lines.zh: 腿短，我躲得有点晚。
lines.en: My legs are short, so I dodge a bit late.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边擦过去，毛都竖了。
lines.en: I brush past your foot with my fur on end.

lines.zh: 撞上以后，我甩甩头清醒一下。
lines.en: After the knock I shake my head clear.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先让了路。
lines.en: We collide and I yield the way first.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我才敢抬头看你。
lines.en: Only once steady do I dare look up at you.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得鼻子发酸。
lines.en: The hit leaves my snout stinging.

lines.zh: 我蹦到一边，回头瞪了你一眼。
lines.en: I hop aside and glare back at you.

lines.zh: 我们鼻子碰鼻子，闻了又闻。
lines.en: We touch snouts and sniff each other over.

lines.zh: 它绕着我蹦，我跟它转圈。
lines.en: It hops around me and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我替它理了理耳后的毛。
lines.en: I tidy the fur behind its ear.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一个浅坑里蹲着。
lines.en: We squat together in a shallow dip.

lines.zh: 它一跳，我就追上去。
lines.en: It hops and I give chase.

lines.zh: 两只小兽并排，尾巴缠在一起。
lines.en: Two small beasts side by side, tails crossing.

lines.zh: 它轻轻碰我的鼻尖，我没躲。
lines.en: It taps my snout and I do not pull away.

lines.zh: 我们一起听同一个方向。
lines.en: We listen toward the same direction.

lines.zh: 它先蹲下，我才跟着蹲。
lines.en: It squats first, and only then do I.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹦，节奏一模一样。
lines.en: We hop abreast in exactly the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 我叼起一只小虫，嚼了两口。
lines.en: I pick up a small bug and chew twice.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住它，再咬。
lines.en: I pin it with my forepaws, then bite.

lines.zh: 地上这颗种子，我收进嘴里。
lines.en: I take the seed from the ground into my mouth.

lines.zh: 这壳太硬，我咬不开。
lines.en: The shell is too hard for me to crack.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片干叶，垫在窝里。
lines.en: I pick up a dry leaf to line my nest.

lines.zh: 我把食物含着，跑回草丛。
lines.en: Food in mouth, I run back into the grass.

lines.zh: 有点苦，我吐了出来。
lines.en: It is bitter, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我边吃边看四周，怕被抢。
lines.en: I eat while watching around, afraid of being robbed.

lines.zh: 我把剩下的塞进颊边。
lines.en: I tuck the rest into my cheek.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我才觉得安心。
lines.en: Only with a full mouth do I feel safe.

lines.zh: 草叶一动，我立刻停住。
lines.en: A blade moves and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我先锁定那个晃动的影子。
lines.en: I fix on that wobbling shadow first.

lines.zh: 个头太大，我盯住它的脚。
lines.en: It is too big, so I watch its feet.

lines.zh: 有东西在挖土，我转头去看。
lines.en: Something is digging and I turn to look.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，锁定了声音。
lines.en: Ears up, I lock onto the sound.

lines.zh: 气味冲过来，我缩了缩身子。
lines.en: The scent hits me and I shrink down.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就准备好要跑。
lines.en: One move from it and I am ready to flee.

lines.zh: 我先叫了一声，试试它反应。
lines.en: I call once to test its reaction.

lines.zh: 锁定的那一刻，我心跳很响。
lines.en: At the moment I lock on, my heart is loud.

lines.zh: 我挑了个死角，再盯住它。
lines.en: I pick a blind spot, then keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 我跟着它挪，一直躲在草里。
lines.en: I shift with it, always hidden in the grass.

lines.zh: 它转向哪边，我就换到另一边。
lines.en: Wherever it turns, I move to the other side.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的腿，数着它的步。
lines.en: I watch its legs and count its steps.

lines.zh: 它靠近一步，我退开一步。
lines.en: It steps closer, I step back.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，连鼻子都不动。
lines.en: I hold my breath and even my snout is still.

lines.zh: 我们隔着草叶对视。
lines.en: We stare at each other through blades of grass.

lines.zh: 它停下，我的尾巴也停了。
lines.en: It stops, and my tail stops too.

lines.zh: 我在算，跳几下能到灌木。
lines.en: I am counting hops to the bush.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我也绕，就是不让它看见。
lines.en: It circles, and I circle to stay unseen.

lines.zh: 只要它低头，我就立刻跑。
lines.en: The moment it lowers its head, I run.

lines.zh: 我蹦起来，咬它的脚趾。
lines.en: I hop up and bite its toes.

lines.zh: 牙齿很小，可我咬得死紧。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but they clamp hard.

lines.zh: 我用前爪抓了一把就跑。
lines.en: I rake with my forepaws and run.

lines.zh: 这一下抓到它的皮了。
lines.en: That one caught its hide.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，立刻弹开。
lines.en: I bite once and spring away.

lines.zh: 它抬脚，我趁空又咬一下。
lines.en: It lifts a foot and I bite again in the gap.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，纯属壮胆。
lines.en: My tail whips out mostly for courage.

lines.zh: 我绕着它蹦，找空子下口。
lines.en: I hop around it, hunting for an opening.

lines.zh: 腿抖得厉害，我还是扑了。
lines.en: My legs shake and still I lunge.

lines.zh: 打完我喘着，躲进草里。
lines.en: Done fighting, I pant and hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 我从草根间冒出来，鼻子先动。
lines.en: I emerge by the grass roots, snout working first.

lines.zh: 一小片平原，够我蹦的了。
lines.en: A small patch of plain, plenty for hopping.

lines.zh: 我跳了两下，确认脚感。
lines.en: I hop twice to check the footing.

lines.zh: 这里的土松，挖起来容易。
lines.en: The soil is loose here and easy to dig.

lines.zh: 同伴从远处跳过来，落在我旁边。
lines.en: A herdmate hops over and lands beside me.

lines.zh: 我先蹲下，看看有没有危险。
lines.en: I squat first and check for danger.

lines.zh: 鼻子告诉我，这地方有虫。
lines.en: My snout tells me there are insects here.

lines.zh: 这是古近纪的欧洲，我认得这味道。
lines.en: This is Paleogene Europe; I know the smell.

lines.zh: 草够高，藏一只我绰绰有余。
lines.en: The grass is tall enough to hide me easily.

lines.zh: 风从背后吹，我换了个方位。
lines.en: The wind is at my back, so I change position.

lines.zh: 我竖起耳朵，听了一会儿。
lines.en: I raise my ears and listen a while.

lines.zh: 跳进来的时候，我踩塌了一小丛草。
lines.en: Coming in, I flattened a small tuft.

lines.zh: 火苗扫过我的毛，我满地乱蹦。
lines.en: Flame sweeps my fur and I bounce about wildly.

lines.zh: 落地太重，我半天没爬起来。
lines.en: I land too hard and cannot get up for a while.

lines.zh: 水涌进鼻子，我拼命往上蹬。
lines.en: Water pours into my snout and I kick upward.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀起来，耳朵全聋了。
lines.en: The blast hurls me up and my ears go dead.

lines.zh: 一根刺扎进腰侧，我疼得直转。
lines.en: A spike lodges in my side and I spin with pain.

lines.zh: 一股怪力裹住我，毛都竖起来。
lines.en: Strange force wraps me and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 饿得我鼻子都不想动了。
lines.en: So hungry that even my snout stops moving.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我整只僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning hits beside me and I lock up entirely.

lines.zh: 我会跳，可这里没有地面。
lines.en: I was built to leap, but there is no ground here.
